BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The malicious object is sent in an HTTP request over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: A single request with a very large length value is enough.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: The attacker needs no account to send the request.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the vulnerable application.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: The loop runs almost indefinitely, so the application hangs or runs out of memory.
